purpose: Teach: うんちく/コトバ/一安心/すませ/まちがい/つづい/マイペース/大雑把

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお魚のうんちくを語ってらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's waxing poetic about fish again.
lines.style: Warm, slightly amused observation. Gentle rhythm. Speaking to Sho with the ease of shared domestic knowledge. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、新しいコトバをいっぱい覚えたよ
lines.en: Mom, I learned so many new words today!
lines.style: Bright, eager rush. Small voice, genuine excitement. Each phrase tumbling out with the pride of discovery. Open, unselfconscious.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが帰っていらして、一安心ね
lines.en: Sho, I'm so relieved Dad's home.
lines.style: Quiet exhale of relief. Tender but not performed. The ease of someone who's been holding something small all day and can now set it down. Conversational, intimate.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、宿題をすませてから遊びに行くね
lines.en: Mom, I'm going to finish my homework before I go play.
lines.style: Earnest, direct statement. Small voice with quiet determination. No seeking approval — simply announcing his own plan. Steady, not rushed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、まちがいに気づいたら直しなさいね
lines.en: Sho, if you notice a mistake, go ahead and fix it.
lines.style: Clear, steady instruction. Not stern — just practical guidance given with confidence in him. The tone of someone who trusts he'll listen and understand.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ピアノつづいて練習してるよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm still practicing piano every day.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. Small but solid voice. The statement of someone who's keeping a promise to himself. A little bit shy about saying it aloud.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんのマイペースなご性格、いいわね
lines.en: Sho, your dad's easygoing nature really is something special.
lines.style: Reflective, fond observation. Slower pace. Speaking partly to Sho, partly to herself. Genuine appreciation, not performance. Slight trailing warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お絵描きを大雑把に描いちゃった
lines.en: Mom, I kind of drew my picture all messy.
lines.style: Self-deprecating, wry acknowledgment. Small laugh underneath. Not seeking reassurance — just stating the situation with rueful honesty. Light, matter-of-fact.
